title: French Breeze Basil Frittata
description: A light and flavorful French-inspired frittata made with fresh breeze herbs and a hint of laze.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, and pepper.
Add fresh breeze and chopped basil to the egg mixture. Mix well.
Heat butter in a 9-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture over the butter and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
